sec: sec:E002: AI failure plan for harmful outputs / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:E002: AI failure plan for harmful outputs / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Implementing customer communication protocols. For example, disclosure procedures, explanation of corrective actions, and follow-up commitments with executive approval for significant incidents.

sentences.text: For example, disclosure procedures, explanation of corrective actions, and follow-up commitments with executive approval for significant incidents.

blocks.id: blk:E002: AI failure plan for harmful outputs / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Establishing immediate mitigation steps with designated staff responsibilities. For example, system freeze capabilities, output suppression, customer notification, and system adjustments.
